name: Tech-Lead Execute — plan, execute, verify, close
description: Wraps the tech-lead card. plan (decompose spec via to-tickets, dispatch via kanban_chains) → verify (adversarial-review) → fix→re-verify loop → close. The plan node blocks on kanban_chains until all dev cards finish. verify FAIL routes to fix loop, not unconditional close.

nodes.body_template:
## Implementation Planning

**Spec card:** ${trigger.card_id}
**Title:** ${trigger.title}

You are the tech-lead. The PO has already written the spec — DO NOT grill the user. Your job is implementation planning.

### Phase 1: Discover

Read the spec card body for full requirements. Read the codebase: AGENTS.md, existing tests, conventions, structure. Understand what exists today.

### Phase 2: Plan (autonomous decomposition)

Load your `to-tickets` skill. Decompose the spec into atomic tasks. For each task:
- Title (short, actionable)
- Acceptance criteria (checklist of testable assertions)
- Dependencies (which tasks must complete before this one)
- Sizing (small/medium/large)

### Phase 3: Dispatch via kanban_chains (CRITICAL)

Call `kanban_chains` to dispatch ALL tasks. This STRUCTURALLY BLOCKS your card until all dev cards reach done.

- One chain per task (if tasks have serial dependencies, put them in the SAME chain as sequential steps)
- Each chain step: {assignee: "developer", title: "[task] <title>", body: "<acceptance criteria + constraints>"}
- Parallel chains for independent tasks
- Your card auto-blocks. Do NOT call kanban_complete. Do NOT create cards via kanban_create.
- The system will auto-promote you when ALL chains finish.

After auto-promotion: read the verifier completion summaries. If ALL PASS → kanban_complete with the plan metadata. If any FAIL → check for fix chains created by the verifier. If any ESCALATE → read the escalation card, classify, and act.

NO human approval needed. NO beads. Fully autonomous.

**Completion metadata:**
```
{plan_complete: true, task_count: N, task_ids: ["t_xxx", ...], sizing_summary: "small:N medium:N large:N"}
```

## Overall Verification — integrated feature

**Spec card:** ${trigger.card_id}
**Tasks completed:** ${nodes.plan.output.task_count}

This is OVERALL verification — not per-task. All developer work is complete. Your job:

1. **Integration check**: do all tasks work TOGETHER? No conflicts, no missing wiring.
2. **Spec compliance**: does the complete implementation satisfy the ORIGINAL spec?
3. **Acceptance criteria**: verify EVERY AC against the integrated code.
4. **Code review**: run adversarial-review on the complete diff.
5. **Edge cases**: falsify the integrated feature — try to break it.

Load your `adversarial-review` skill.

**Verdict:**
- PASS (zero findings): merge to main, complete with verdict=PASS
- FAIL (any findings): complete with verdict=FAIL and stamp findings in metadata. Do NOT create fix cards — the workflow template handles routing.
- ESCALATE (spec gap): complete with verdict=ESCALATE

**Completion metadata:**
```
{verdict: "PASS"|"FAIL"|"ESCALATE", findings_count: N, acs_verified: N, acs_total: N}
```

## Fix findings from overall verification

**Spec card:** ${trigger.card_id}
**Verify card:** check this board for the verify card with verdict=FAIL
**Findings count:** ${nodes.verify.output.findings_count}

The overall verifier found issues with the integrated work. Read the verifier's findings on the verify card. Each finding has: ID, severity, file:line, title, and repro.

Fix ALL findings (Critical, Important, Minor). Commit on the same branch. Run the full test suite to confirm all tests pass.

Write a completion comment listing each finding ID and how it was addressed.

**Completion metadata:**
```
{fixed: true, findings_fixed: N, tests_pass: N}
```

## Re-verify after integration fix

**Spec card:** ${trigger.card_id}
**Fix card:** ${nodes.fix.output.findings_fixed} findings fixed

Re-run the overall verification on the fixed code. Same standards as the first verify. Check that each previously-found finding is resolved. Also run a fresh-eyes pass — look for NEW issues introduced by the fix.

Load your `adversarial-review` skill.

**Verdict:**
- PASS (zero findings): merge to main, complete with verdict=PASS
- FAIL: complete with verdict=FAIL and stamp findings in metadata
- ESCALATE: complete with verdict=ESCALATE

**Completion metadata:**
```
{verdict: "PASS"|"FAIL"|"ESCALATE", findings_count: N}
```
